end.summary:
Practised distinguishing points, line segments, lines and rays by endpoints and arrows.
Aryan identified rays using the torch-beam example and line segments using two endpoints.
They explained that a line extends forever and a segment has measurable length.
A mix-up about a longer drawn line being a different line was corrected in the next two responses.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying figures from their endpoints, arrows and whether the length is fixed. Aryan used the torch-beam example for rays and explained the difference between a segment and a line; the idea that a 12 cm drawing is a different or “longer” line was corrected by focusing on the figure’s endpoints and arrows. At home, ask them to sort simple drawings into point, segment, line and ray and explain the rule for each.
